name: probability_currents
caption: Frobenius norm of the K×K microstate current J_ij = π_i T_ij − π_j T_ji, with a 95% trajectory-bootstrap CI. This is not H4 (macrostate currents). Prefill / bge-m3 excludes 0; the other qwen and 120b intervals reach ~0. That is not a claim that 'qwen is at equilibrium'.
alt_text: Frobenius norm of the K×K microstate current J_ij = π_i T_ij − π_j T_ji, with a 95% trajectory-bootstrap CI. This is not H4 (macrostate currents). Prefill / bge-m3 excludes 0; the other qwen and 120b intervals reach ~0. That is not a claim that 'qwen is at equilibrium'.
limitations: ‖J‖_F summarises a K×K micro-MSM. A sliding loop chopped into k-means cells can carry a small directed current that is not semantic circulation. The point estimate can sit above the CI upper bound. Glimmer n=2 is underpowered. Bootstrap is over trajectories, not chunks.
